# Test fixtures

`roms/machines/glabios/GLABIOS_0.4.0_8X.ROM`: GLaBIOS 0.4.0, the 8088 XT
build, by 640KB (https://github.com/640-KB/GLaBIOS), GPL-3.0-only. It is
the one PC BIOS the tests may carry, so CI can boot a machine (86Box's
`glabios`) with no IBM, AMI or Award image. Taken from 86Box's ROM set,
tag v6.0.
